correctness.rationale: The polytope is the hypersimplex clipped at the one deleted vertex, with exactly 2n coordinate facets plus the rank-(k-1) hyperplane facet. At each permitted vertex, n coordinate rays plus zero or one new ray generate the normal cone. The exact toric divisor map from saturated M={m:sum m=0} has quotient Z (ordinary) or Z² (neighbor), without torsion. Cartier/Q-Cartier imposes the unique m_i=+1 for i∈B and -1 otherwise, with total sum 2k-n and extra pairing k-2, yielding the asserted exact criterion. Replayed checker verifies 682 fixed-point configurations and 170 facet-support checks for n=6..9; finite tests are not an infinite proof. Definition ranges include both k and n-k >=3.

value.rationale: The one-circuit-hyperplane matroid is the simplest sparse-paving departure from a uniform matroid. Its new facet changes the intrinsic integral local Weil-divisor class group at exactly k(n-k) fixed points and creates a sharp additional Cartier obstruction even when the ambient rank is balanced. This complete per-vertex classification captures information not obtainable from published aggregate face counts or the global Gorenstein classification alone; it is a motivated structural base case for multi-circuit matroid toric singularities.
